advice.text: Almost nothing reaches In 2 (loudest tone -90 dBFS, noise -115 dBFS; loop gain -44 dB). Check the Main knob (Out 1/2 are the Main outputs: turn it fully up), that the cable runs from Main Out R to In 2, and the UC mixer (DAW 2 unmuted, Main not muted).
